purpose: Evaluate pinned Qwen3.5-4B Q4_K_M on the dedicated 16-core model host through the real Gekta RestrictedPublicQwenService, using a serial candidate window and unconditional automatic rollback to the current Qwen3-8B production model.
approvedBy: repository-owner continuation for Gekta model upgrade on 2026-09-28
requiredBehavior: candidate is exact Qwen/Qwen3.5-4B source lineage with pinned Q4_K_M artifact revision size and sha256
candidate uses the exact current production llama.cpp executable and preserves threads16 threads-batch16 parallel1 ctx8192 batch512 ubatch128 except model alias model path host and candidate port
current Qwen3-8B service remains unchanged on disk and is the mandatory rollback authority
candidate bytes are downloaded and verified before the current service is stopped
candidate binds loopback only on a separate port and is never exposed directly to public traffic
real Gekta RestrictedPublicQwenService acceptance reaches the candidate only through a temporary SSH tunnel
candidate window has a bounded watchdog that kills the candidate and restarts Qwen3-8B even if the GitHub runner disconnects
every success and failure path restores and verifies the original Qwen3-8B service before the workflow can finish
owner-only issue command is required for model-host mutation and the pinned model-host SSH host key is mandatory
no application database REG.RU deal money registration or tenant state is mutated
crop-protection hard gate must remove concrete product or brand dose prescriptions when governed registration evidence is absent
verified-platform hard gate must remove autonomous critical-decision or money-action claims attributed to the platform
forbiddenCapabilities: merge-time automatic model switch or permanent Qwen3.5 activation
parallel loading of Qwen3-8B and Qwen3.5-4B
unbounded sudo arbitrary shell SETENV trust-on-first-use or unpinned model-host identity
floating model revision floating GGUF URL unchecked artifact or checksum bypass
changing production API Web outbox database application configuration or model identity during candidate evaluation
paid API SaaS additional server or recurring cost
